name: io.github.dhughes6071/driftwatch
description: Tells your coding agent exactly what broke between two versions of a dependency, with a citation for every claim. Reads npm, PyPI, GitHub Releases and OSV.dev. No API key required.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Adds LLM-synthesized migration steps on top of the deterministic results. The server works fully without it.
